name: AI-powered B2B Lead Generation Agent
description: An open-source, self-hosted AI agent designed to generate B2B leads by analyzing product descriptions, identifying fitting leads, explaining relevance, and emailing prospects directly from the user's mailbox via a command-line interface.

inputs.name: product_description
inputs.description: A detailed description of the user's product or service used to identify matching leads.

inputs.name: mailbox_credentials
inputs.description: Authentication details (e.g., username, password, API key) for the user's email mailbox to send outreach emails.

inputs.name: lead_criteria
inputs.description: Additional filtering parameters or attributes defining the characteristics of ideal leads.

inputs.name: email_template
inputs.description: Template for the outreach email content, which may include placeholders to be dynamically filled.

outputs.name: lead_list
outputs.description: A collection of identified leads with profiles matching the product description and criteria.

outputs.name: lead_explanations
outputs.description: Explanations justifying why each identified lead fits the described product.

outputs.name: sent_emails_report
outputs.description: A report summarizing the status and details of emails sent to the identified leads.

patterns: AI-driven lead identification from product descriptions
Contextual explanation generation for lead relevance
Automated personalized email generation and delivery
steps: User inputs a detailed product description and optional lead criteria.
AI agent analyzes the product description to identify suitable leads matching the profile.
For each lead, the agent generates explanations describing why the lead fits the product.
User configures mailbox credentials and email templates for outreach.
The system sends personalized emails to each lead from the user's mailbox.
Agent provides a status report on the outreach emails sent.
use_cases: Startups seeking targeted B2B leads for new product launches.
Sales teams automating personalized outreach at scale.
Marketing departments improving lead quality with AI insights.
Businesses wanting a self-hosted, privacy-focused lead generation tool.

prompt_templates.name: lead_identification_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Describe your product: {product_description}. Find leads that fit this description.

prompt_templates.name: lead_explanation_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Explain why this person is a good fit: {lead_profile} for the product described as {product_description}.

prompt_templates.name: email_generation_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Generate a personalized outreach email for lead {lead_name} based on the following template: {email_template}.
